profile.headline: Software Engineer React Web/Native & Full Stack
profile.summary:
React Web & Native + Full Stack Software Engineer who loves building meaningful applications that can make an impact and contribute to society. Fast learner, able to master new concepts and skills quickly, if I don’t know it, I can learn it and be efficient. I enjoy learning and adapting to new technologies.
I believe it is all in the details. I'm attentive & analytic; a meticulous problem-solver that likes to think strategically about solutions & detailed steps required to get from present to precise completion.

I also have experience in Project Management, Agile development & SCRUM methodologies.
As a React Web & React Native developer I've  had the chance to learn the suite of React technologies such as Redux, GraphQL, Typescript and have worked with Hasura, Storybook, JSON, Apollo, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Firebase / Firestore, Java, HTML, CSS, Git/Hub, Bitbucket, Jira, Asana, Slack / Discord, C#/++, SQL, AWS services (DynamoDB, S3, Amplify).
I love learning about different topics(not just tech), and enjoy mentoring others in React practices & those starting out in the tech field.

*Open to remote C2C/1099 contracts focused on ReactJS Web or React Native (iOS/Android) development.*

positions.title: Founder & CEO
positions.description: RevampTech specializes in making web & mobile apps with React / Native, with the goal of building useful applications that can have an impact on society, focused on helping non-profits & small-medium organizations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software for Loan origination, re-imagined. On a mission of equitable access to affordable capital for all.
LoanWell is building the "Squarespace for Lenders"​ with an end-to-end platform for intake, origination, underwriting, closing, servicing, and reporting. 
Customizable origination process enables user account management and gathers applicant information and required documents securely. Automated email follow up to guide the borrower to application completion. Closing process allows any lender to add their own closing documents and create an e-signature session for all parties embedded directly into the system.
For any Loan Funds, CDFIs, Foundations doing PRI Lending, Community Banks or Credit Unions that may need customized technology. Learn more at: https://loanwell.com or email team@loanwell.com

positions.title: Co-Founder Member & Software Engineer
positions.description: Co-founding member worked on the planning, feasibility study, creation & recruiting of Radiate NC Tech Cooperative. Radiate Consulting NC is a Tech Cooperative, our member-owners build high-quality custom web & mobile applications that help non-profit organizations, universities, and small businesses meet their tech needs. We partner directly with clients to bring support and provide expertise where needed.

positions.description:
"Tech for Good: Building Community Through the Power of Technology", RIoT Studios, event panelist.

"A career option for DREAMers: Earning a living through co-ops ". Event panelist, Democracy at Work Institute.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack React engineer, project manager, and mentor for Web and Mobile applications. Responsibilities include interacting with clients to turn their ideas into a working product, taking part in the engineering and project management of React Web and React Native applications that utilize Redux, Typescript, GraphQL, Apollo, Hasura, as well as PSQL, Ruby on Rails and NodeJS. In addition to development, responsibilities include mentoring and leading interns in front end React web and React native development.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Help start-ups develop & build their React & React Native product, as well as run a diversity-aimed React engineering training program. THT is a team of specialists with one mission: to make adding mobile & web support to your business easy.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Cloud Firestore · Redux Thunk · React Native · Firebase

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
ClinWiki.org takes the public clinical trial database and enables the crowd to annotate, structure and rate trials in the style of Wikipedia and Yelp while providing improved search tools. Developed in React + Full Stack, used Typescript, Redux, GraphQL, Hasura, Apollo, PostgreSQL, Ruby on Rails and NodeJS.
ClinWiki gives transparent and relevant views of clinical trials for patients and physicians so they can find and choose the best trial options. The result is improved results for patients, increased participation and ultimately improved trials and faster progress against serious diseases. - ClinWiki is a 501(c)(3). 
Code is Open Source, available at:  https://github.com/clinwiki-org & the data is crowd sourced.
